responsibility: Provides the no-Objective-C fallback implementation for the front end’s Objective-C integration hooks. When Objective-C support is disabled, this file installs a stub `Objc` implementation and selector helpers that reject Objective-C class/interface usage and assert if selector creation or lookup is attempted, allowing the rest of the front end to call a uniform API regardless of build configuration.
same_name_distinction: This `.c` file is the no-Objective-C implementation for the `objc` interface; unlike `objc.h`, which defines the abstract Objective-C interop API and selector metadata types, it installs the stub backend that reports Objective-C classes/interfaces as unsupported and asserts on selector creation or lookup when Objective-C support is disabled.
